programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go North
programme.desc: Northumberland. Si and Dave continue their adventure in Northumberland. They eat fresh seafood in the seaside town of Amble and sample the ultimate fish and chips in Bamburgh. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Jamie: Fast And Simple
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver strips back cooking to its essentials and shares his innovative ways to speed up time in the kitchen, with delicious results. S1, Ep3

programme.title: New: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Past Comes Back To Haunt You. The final bakers dissect their desserts and take on a time-travelling monster mash for the championship title and the $25,000 prize! S10, Ep7

programme.title: New: Halloween Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Day After And Ancient Coffin. Four top cookie makers reveal how the creepers relax the day after Halloween and try to bury the competition with 3D ancient coffins. S2, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Ten bakers remain and their bread making skills are put to the test. Judges Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry keep a close eye on the bakers who face three more difficult challenges. S2, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The showstopper challenge sees the remaining bakers attempt to bake and present a macaroon display that tastes as good as it looks. Who will be eliminated from the competition? S2, Ep4

programme.title: New: Secrets Of The Caribbean Kitchen
programme.desc: Award winning chef Keshia Sakarah takes a journey into the heart of Caribbean cooking, uncovering the stories behind the islands' most loved recipes. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Memory Lane. There's a trip down memory lane for Tom and his team as they celebrate the pub's 10th anniversary. They make a dish inspired by his childhood. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh Is Best. Tom puts a spotlight on some fresh ingredients. Tom and his team debut a new sea bass dish and a delicious starter of courgettes and goat's cheese. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: The Classics. Chef Asma Khan enjoys timeless Indian classics, from a delicious dal and jhal farezi to tangy aloo gobi matter and historic 1st Class Railway Curry. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Burgers, Tacos And Dogs. Guy Fieri drives in for fast food done right in Houston, Milwaukee and then Reseda, California. Dishes include burgers topped with mac and cheese. S7, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Name That Cook. Guy Fieri checks out three local favourites where the sign says who's cooking! On the menu are pork chops with polenta, onion burgers and Trinidad classics. S7, Ep3
